_about: Projects written for each work profile (src/config/profiles.ts). level decides the programs: nocode = Applied AI Practitioner; lead = AI Leadership + Applied AI Practitioner; analytics = Data & Business Analytics + Data Science & GenAI Program; build = GenAI & Agentic AI Master; ml = Data Science & GenAI Master + MS CS + Data Science & GenAI Program; cloud = Cloud & DevOps Engineering (Network track) + AI-Powered Cloud & DevOps Master. Load with: npm run db:seed-profile-projects

robotics-automation.title: AI Robot Path Optimisation Agent
